results.test: S structure + binding frames + tip gripper
D2 dose A03 10 uL: all monitors pass, commit, volumes, tip in waste
D3 wrong reagent: aborted before tip pick / aspiration, routed H4 / human
D4 tip missing at the next rack position: no tip, aborted, nothing aspirated
D5 low reagent (60 uL vs 1000 uL believed): cLLD deviation, aborted before aspiration
D6 clog: pressure at the clog limit, less volume, dose uncertain (not committed)
D7 plate removed: identity / seating fail, aborted
results.aborted: plate not verified / not seated / well not bound

results.test: D8 Cell 01 records validate; only the nominal dose commits
